name_reason: Compliant with data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: domain=ui, descriptor=item_command_menu_state_template. 'state_template' correctly reflects the data role (per-option enable/disable flag template) and distinguishes it from the companion option-id list data_fd2_ui_item_command_menu_template @ 0x51F05. No Ghidra address residue. Matches the sibling *_menu_state_template family in uitab.c (field_command / game_options / player_action / save_load).
purpose: Per-option enable/disable flag template for the battle item command submenu (Use / Give / Sort-Equip / Drop); copied onto the stack at menu-open time and mutated locally to grey out options.
logic_summary: int32[4] all-zero source template. Sole reader fd2_item_command_menu_dispatch (@ 0x1BC0A) REP-MOVSDs the 4 dwords (MOV ECX,4; MOV ESI,0x53F32; REP MOVSD) into a local menu_state[16] buffer, paired with the option-id template @ 0x51F05 copied into menu_options[16]. When fd2_compute_aoe_targets(cursor, range 1, kind 3 ally) returns 0 (no adjacent ally tile in range) it sets the local copy element [1] (byte offset 4) to 1 to grey out the Give option, then hands the local copy to fd2_count_active_menu_items_until_zero / fd2_open_settings_dialog_with_slide / fd2_settings_menu_input_step. The global itself is never written.
element_semantics: 4 x int32 per-option enable/disable flags, indexed 0..3 matching the Use/Give/Sort-Equip/Drop options of the paired option-id template @ 0x51F05; value 0 = option selectable, non-zero = greyed out. All entries 0 at rest (statically all selectable); the Give entry (index 1) is set to 1 only on the local stack copy when no ally tile is adjacent.
notes: Existing src comment (uitab.c lines 255-275) is already precise, complete and ASCII-only; verified every claim against decompile + disassembly (REP MOVSD count 4 from 0x53F32 at 0001bc01-0001bc0f; Give greyout MOV dword [ESP+0x48],1 at 0001bc58 gated on fd2_compute_aoe_targets result; cursor dispatch CMP [0x53c57] 0/1/2/else). No src edit needed -> uitab.c not staged. is_const=false matches live declaration (int32, non-const) and the deliberate sibling state-template family convention (option templates const, state templates non-const) even though the game never writes the global. Ghidra plate was null; created a concise PLATE_COMMENT consistent with the src conclusion.
